source.cdragonBinFieldHashAlgorithm: 32-bit FNV-1a of the lowercased UTF-8 field name; only exact hash-to-template-token matches are resolved.

ability.desc: Slam the target dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Golem Smash

ability.desc: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Occasionally dash around the board.
ability.name: Swimming Speed

ability.desc: The Training Dummy cannot move or attack. It is also dressed like a devilishly handsome Yordle.
ability.name: On Duty!

ability.desc: The Voidspawn gains bonus Health and Attack Damage based on the current Stage.
ability.name: Voidborn

ability.desc: Passive: Heal to full Health whenever an allied Krug dies.
ability.name: Stone Salvage

ability.desc: Passive: Leap to the enemy backline at the beginning of combat.
ability.name: Pack Attack

ability.desc: Passive: Leap to the enemy backline at the beginning of combat.
ability.name: Pack Attack

ability.desc: Passive: Gain Attack Speed whenever an allied Razorbeak dies.
ability.name: Furious Flock

ability.desc: Passive: Gain Attack Speed whenever an allied Razorbeak dies.
ability.name: Furious Flock

ability.desc: Combat start: Charge forward, dealing <magicDamage>@MaxHealthPct*100@%</magicDamage> max Health magic damage and stunning enemies.
ability.name: Void Charge

ability.desc: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Attacks splash in a cone behind the target.
ability.name: Primordial Breath

ability.desc:
<Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @PoisonDurationAP@ seconds.

<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Heavily slows the target.</dim>

Purple Buff: Every @TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains @TraitTimedAP@ Ability Power.
ability.name: Belchy Bubble

ability.desc: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% bonus physical damage.\n\nGrey Buff: Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.
ability.name: Rending Claws

ability.desc: Begin consuming @PercentManaPerSecond@ max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @MRReduction@.\n\nTeal Buff: Gain @TraitManaRegenTooltip@ Mana Regen for every @TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.
ability.name: Azure Laser

ability.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and applying @WoundLevel@% <Keyword>Wound</Keyword> and @BurnAmount@% <Keyword>Burn</Keyword> for @WoundDuration@ seconds.

Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains @TraitADOnCast@ Attack Damage each cast.

<rules>Wound: Reduces healing received.</rules>
<rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</rules>
ability.name: Razor Leaves

ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</bright> Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 

Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.
ability.name: Can You Dig It?

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.
ability.name: Rock and Roll

ability.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</keyword> for @ManaReaveFlat@.

Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</rules>
ability.name: Azure Shockwave

ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

<bright>Active:</bright> Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Armor.

Red Buff: Attacks @BurnAmount@% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.
ability.name: Crimson Fury

ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.
ability.name: Deadly Plumage

ability.desc: <Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a cone. \n\n<Bright>Quest:</Bright> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by @DamageTaken3StarScalar@ at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: Bellows Breath

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</dim>
ability.name: Javelin Toss

ability.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Spirit of Dread

ability.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. \n\nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Forest's Flurry and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).
ability.name: Forest's Flurry

ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.
ability.name: Arise!

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Restore @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them.
ability.name: Uproot

ability.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @Stack@% %i:scaleAP%
ability.name: Primordial Burst

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.
ability.name: Sow the Seeds

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.
ability.name: Petrified Bark

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.
ability.name: Last Rites

ability.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.
ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% physical damage in a large cone.
ability.name: Haymaker

ability.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.
ability.name: Spirit Bomb

ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</Keyword> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>
ability.name: Spirit Rift

ability.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Spider Queen

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.
ability.name: Headshot

ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.
ability.name: Noxious Blast

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% more damage per curse.
ability.name: Withering Curse

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Entrancing Dance

ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.
ability.name: Lilting Lullaby

ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Dance of Life

ability.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</bright> @RedRerolls@ Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Green:</bright> @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Yellow:</bright> @YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: Fungus Among Us

ability.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.\n\nWhen the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.
ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.
ability.name: Rage Gene

ability.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% for each attack while casting.\n\n<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</Rules>
ability.name: Explosive Charge

ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.
ability.name: Boomerang Blade

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Furious Fists

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</keyword>, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</dim>
ability.name: Kunai Strike

ability.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).
ability.name: Piercing Arrow

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</Keyword>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</Rules>
ability.name: Tantrum

ability.desc: Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</Keyword> enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each. \n\nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Firestorm

ability.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. \n\nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.
ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Pale Barrier

ability.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each.\n\nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.
ability.name: Moonfall

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Start combat with @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Shield Bash

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</Bright> Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks @ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</Keyword> enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</Bright> Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</Rules>
ability.name: Solar Judgement

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies hit.
ability.name: Sun's Wrath

ability.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within @LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage instead and gain @IsolateManaGrant@ mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: Taste Their Fear

ability.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, increased to up to @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: Savagery

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor</Bright> %i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. Enemies below @ADBonusDamageThreshold@ max Health take @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage instead.\n\n<dim>Adaptor</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Damages enemies over time.</dim>
ability.name: Raining Artillery

ability.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Rampant Growth

ability.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each over the duration.
ability.name: Harvest

ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Starcall

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.
ability.name: Emerald Radiance

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</Keyword>. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.
ability.name: Triggerseed

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.
ability.name: Final Spark

ability.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Triumphant Roar

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit. If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.
ability.name: Whirling Death

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.  Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</Bright>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.

Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.
ability.name: Heat Without Equal

ability.desc: Tether the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all enemies in a @AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @SlowPercent@% <keyword>Slowing</keyword> them for @SlowDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>
ability.name: Karmic Bond

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@ chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@ per takedown.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% to adjacent enemies.
ability.name: Mirror Image

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.

<Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%: Double Strikes grant @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% stacking Attack Speed.

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>阵亡时，分裂成两个【小型石甲虫】，每个拥有@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值，并且它们会立即进行嘲讽从而迫使敌人们对其进行攻击。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>获得@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%最大生命值，然后滚向目标，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%伤害。

蓝灰霸符：阵亡时，【石甲虫】和【小型石甲虫】为友军提供@TraitShieldHealth@最大生命值的护盾值。
ability.name: 岩之摇滚

ability.desc:
获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%护盾值。猛击地面，向敌人最密集的方向发出一道裂隙。被命中的敌人会被短暂击飞，受到@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@ManaReaveFlat@<keyword>破法</keyword>。

蓝霸符：【苍蓝雕纹魔像】每次施放技能时，友军们就会获得@TraitAlliesManaRegen@法力回复。

<rules>破法：提升下一次技能施放的法力消耗。</rules>
ability.name: 蔚蓝冲击波

ability.desc:
<bright>被动：</bright>当目标阵亡时，跃至下个目标，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%物理伤害。

<bright>主动：</bright>获得持续@Duration@秒的@FrenzyADPercent@物理加成。在此期间，无视@GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%护甲。

红霸符：攻击@BurnAmount@%灼烧敌人并治疗【绯红印记树怪】@TraitMaxHealthHeal@最大生命值。
ability.name: 猩红之怒

ability.desc: 下@NumAttacks@次攻击获得@AttackSpeed@攻击速度。这些攻击会被替换为羽刃，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害和@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护甲削减。
ability.name: 致死羽衣

ability.desc: <Bright>主动：</Bright>获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，并对一个锥形范围内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n<Bright>任务：</Bright>每场玩家对战，【奥恩】将已格挡的伤害储存为【锻炉能量】，在3星时提升@DamageTaken3StarScalar@。他每次获得足够的【锻炉能量】时，就会获得1个【神器锻造器】。<Rules>（锻炉能量：</Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>）</Rules>
ability.name: 风箱炎息

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>：</Bright>下@NumEmpoweredAttacks@次攻击获得@BonusAttackSpeed@攻击速度。这些攻击被替换为标枪，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。第3次攻击转而瞄准相距最远且携带最少装备的那个敌人，并造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>：变形为一只近战美洲狮刺客来挥击敌人们。</dim>
ability.name: 标枪投掷

ability.desc: 获得持续3秒的@Resists@护甲与魔抗，并在此期间持续回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。向相距最近的@NumEnemies@名敌人派出幽魂骑兵，从而对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 恐惧之灵

ability.desc: 闪烁远离当前目标，对其造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，并获得@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%攻击速度。\n\n每第四次施放时，会消耗来自【森林疾风】的攻击速度，并释放一道贯穿最大的敌群的震波来造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，它每穿过一个敌人就会降低@DamageReductionPerHit@伤害(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。
ability.name: 森林疾风

ability.desc: 接下来的@NumAttacks@次攻击获得@AttackSpeed@攻击速度并召唤@SoldiersToSpawn@个士兵。这些攻击会被替换为指令，来命令每个士兵进行攻击，每次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 沙兵现身

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>每秒回复@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%生命值，施放技能后的@SpellMultiplierDuration@秒内该效果变为3倍。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>冲出地面，使邻格的敌人们晕眩@KnockupDuration@秒并对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 破土而出

ability.desc:
向目标发射一记巨大震波，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，若其生命值低于@HPThreshold@最大生命值，则提升至@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%。

若目标阵亡，则永久获得@APOnKill@%法术加成。

当前加成：@Stack@% %i:scaleAP%
ability.name: 能量爆裂

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每格挡@DamageMitigatedPerSapling@伤害后，一株树苗会跳向附近的一名敌人并造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%魔法伤害。阵亡时，@SaplingsOnDeath@株树苗会跳出。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>对目标造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%魔法伤害并回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%+@ActiveMissingHealthHeal@已损失生命值。
ability.name: 播种

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，并进入石化状态。护盾被打破时，释放一道黑暗能量波，对@AoEHexRange@格内的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 石化树皮

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>阵亡时，生成一个拥有@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%最大生命值的【夜幽游灵】，并且它会立即进行嘲讽从而迫使敌人们对其进行攻击。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值并打击目标，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。
ability.name: 临终仪式

ability.desc: 冲刺并向当前目标发射一颗法球，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害并分裂，对附近的@NumSecondaryTargets@名敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。
ability.name: 灵蕴拳

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每场战斗中首次跌至@ManaHPThreshold@最大生命值以下时，获得100法力值。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>蓄力打出一记重拳，从而快速回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值，随后在一个大型锥形范围内造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。
ability.name: 蓄意轰拳

ability.desc: 对@AbilityCenterHexRange@格内被最多敌人环绕的那个位置发射一颗灵魄炸弹。它对半径@HexRadius@格内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，与中心的距离每增加1格，该伤害就会衰减@HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@。
ability.name: 灵魄炸弹

ability.desc:
沿敌人最多的那条直线发射一支箭矢，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，这个伤害每命中一个敌人就会衰减@DamageFalloffPerEnemy@(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。如果没有命中任何敌人，则返还@ManaRefund@的法力值花费。

这支箭矢会留下一道持续@RiftDuration@秒的痕迹，对其中的敌人每秒造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%+@MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@最大生命值物理伤害，并施加@ChillPercent@%<Keyword>缓速</Keyword>效果。

<Rules>缓速：降低攻击速度</Rules>
ability.name: 灵魂裂隙

ability.desc: 变身为蜘蛛，并获得@SpiderHealthBuff@最大生命值。处于蜘蛛形态时的攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害，并治疗自身@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。后续施放提供在@ASBuffDuration@秒内持续衰减的@DecayingAS@攻击速度。
ability.name: 蜘蛛女皇

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每第三次攻击会被替换为一次爆头，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。
ability.name: 爆头

ability.desc: 向目标和相距最近未中毒的敌人投毒，从而在@Duration@秒利持续造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。这个毒可以叠加。
ability.name: 瘟毒爆炸

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>获得@Omnivamp@全能吸血。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>向附近@NumEnemiesCursed@个敌人发射一道黑暗震波，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并诅咒他们@SpellDuration@秒。然后，生成一个半径@HexRangeAOE@格的枯萎地带，持续相同时长并且每秒造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。被诅咒的敌人们受到@MagicDamageCalc3@%i:scaleAP%x诅咒数的额外伤害。
ability.name: 枯萎诅咒

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值。然后为本回合造成伤害最高的友军提供在@AttackSpeedDuration@秒内持续衰减的@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%攻击速度。
ability.name: 登场之舞

ability.desc: 回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值，并向附近的敌人们放出@NumEnemiesToFireAt@只蝴蝶。在命中敌人时造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并施加@SleepDuration@秒昏睡。如果目标受到的伤害达到@DamageNeededToAwaken@，则会醒来并额外受到@WakeupDamage@最大生命值的魔法伤害。
ability.name: 夜阑谣

ability.desc: 在@Duration@秒里持续回复共@HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值。下一次攻击被替换为猛击，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 生命之舞

ability.desc:
投掷2簇蘑菇，对相距最近的@NumEnemiesHit@个敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。然后猛摔出一个巨型蘑菇，对目标造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。

每次施放有@PercentChanceOfForage@几率搜寻到一个额外的蘑菇，可供收集以获得额外效果。

<bright>红蘑菇：</bright> @RedRerolls@次刷新<Rules>(已搜寻到的红蘑菇：</Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>绿蘑菇：</bright> @GreenHealth@小小英雄生命值<Rules>(已搜寻到的绿蘑菇：</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>黄蘑菇：</bright> @YellowXP@经验值<Rules>(已搜寻到的黄蘑菇：</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: 内有真菌

ability.desc: 嘲讽，从而强迫附近的敌人们攻击该弈子。获得持续@Duration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值和@ArmorMR@护甲与魔抗。\n\n护盾被打破时，对@DamageHexRange@格内的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%物理伤害。
ability.name: 尖刺防御

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>每秒获得@RagePerSecond@怒气并且每次攻击提供@RagePerAttack@怒气。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>变形为【巨型纳尔】并跃至@TransformSearchRadius@格内最大的敌群。然后，对@TransformHexRadius@格内的敌人们造成@PhysicalDamageCalc3@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，将其护甲和魔抗降低@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%，并令其晕眩@StunDuration@秒。【巨型纳尔】获得@HealthCalc1@生命值，并将其技能替换为“抓投”。

<Bright>抓投：</Bright>抓住目标并将其投向相距最远的那个敌人，对主要目标造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，并对途经的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。如果目标是最后存活的1名敌人，则转而将其抛出战场。
ability.name: 狂怒基因

ability.desc: 将一个爆炸火花吸附到目标上，持续@Duration@秒。生效期间，获得无限射程和@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%攻击速度。持续时间结束后，爆炸火花会爆炸并造成由2格内的所有敌人间分摊的伤害，伤害值为@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害+施放期间每次攻击提供额外@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。\n\n<Rules>如果携带爆炸火花的敌人阵亡，那么爆炸火花会吸附至【崔丝塔娜】的新目标。</Rules>
ability.name: 爆炸火花

ability.desc: 投掷一把巨大的十字刃，它会对当前敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，并在附近敌人之间弹跳@NumBounces@次，每次弹跳造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。当这个技能击杀了一个敌人，它会额外弹跳@BonusKillBounces@次。
ability.name: 回旋之刃

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>攻击时，回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>发出一声原始怒吼，从而回复@HealthCalc3@%i:scaleAP%生命值。然后获得@SpellAS@攻击速度、@SpellDurability@伤害减免和不可阻挡效果，持续@SpellDuration@秒。
ability.name: 狂怒之拳

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>：</Bright>对目标发射一连串苦无，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。如果目标处于<keyword>灼烧</keyword>状态，则额外造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>：若该技能完成击杀，则再次施放它。</dim>
ability.name: 苦无打击

ability.desc: 蓄力，然后向目标所在且敌人最多的一条直线射出箭矢。它对命中的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，每穿过一个敌人，该伤害降低@DamageReductionPerHit@(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。
ability.name: 穿刺之箭

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>每秒回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值并对@PassiveHexRadius@格内的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@魔法伤害。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>对@BigHexRadius@格内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc3@魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩，如果目标处于<Keyword>灼烧</Keyword>状态则延长至@GenericCalc1@秒。

<Rules>灼烧：每秒造成目标一部分最大生命值的真实伤害。</Rules>
ability.name: 勃然大怒

ability.desc: 蓄力，每有一名被<Keyword>灼烧</Keyword>的敌人便获得@APPerBurningEnemy@法术加成。随后，获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，然后冲刺穿过附近的一群敌人，对每个敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n冲刺后，释放一场半径@FirestormHexRadius@格的火焰风暴，在@FirestormDuration@秒内持续造成共计@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，由所有被命中的敌人均摊。
ability.name: 火焰风暴

ability.desc: 装备断魄，并在@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAS%秒内对目标连续挥击@Duration@次，每次造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。\n\n攻势结束后，发射一道月光，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，由半径2格内的所有敌人分摊。
ability.name: 月光对影

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@护盾值，并放出@NumOrbs@颗月光法球，由2格内的所有敌人分摊，每颗造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 苍白屏障

ability.desc: 向@NumEnemies@个最近的敌人降下@NumMoonshards@枚月光碎片，每枚造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n满月时，月曜降临，造成由所有敌人分摊的@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 月之降临

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>在战斗开始时获得@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外护甲和魔抗，在@DecayDuration@秒内持续衰减。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>猛击当前目标，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleArmor%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 护盾猛击

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>【凯尔】基于其星级获得飞升，并获得可叠加的增益。

<Bright>第1次飞升：</Bright> 普攻造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害。
<Bright>第2次飞升：</Bright> 普攻对命中的敌人施加持续@ShredDuration@秒的@ShredLevel@%<Keyword>魔抗击碎</Keyword>。
<Bright>第3次飞升：</Bright> 普攻发射冲击波，对命中的所有其他弈子造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
<Bright>第4次飞升：</Bright> 获得无限距离。每第@NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@次焰浪变得更大。

<Rules>魔抗击碎：降低魔抗值</Rules>
ability.name: 太阳裁决

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%护盾值。然后在一个锥形范围内进行顺劈以造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，并沿直线进行打击，对被命中的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 烈阳之怒

ability.desc: 跃向@LeapRangeHexes@格内相距最远的敌人，对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。如果其邻格没有其友军，则转而造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并获得@IsolateManaGrant@法力值。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: 品尝恐惧

ability.desc: 跳向@JumpHexRange@格内生命值百分比最低的那个敌人并刺击，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。然后治疗@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP% 生命值，治疗量基于已损失的生命值至多到 @HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: 残忍无情

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>：</Bright>向目标和相距最近的一个其他敌人喷射酸液，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。低于@ADBonusDamageThreshold@最大生命值的敌人们转而受到@PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>：对敌人持续造成伤害。</dim>
ability.name: 天降重炮

ability.desc: 在战场周围生成@NumPlantsToSpawn@株植物，它们会攻击相距最近的敌人@ThornSpitterNumAttacks@次。每次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 狂野生长

ability.desc: 使@NumTargets@个相距最近的敌人的魔抗降低@MRReduction@。然后在@CastDuration@秒里持续从它们身上汲取生命力，从而治疗自身@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值并在此期间持续对每个敌人造成共@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 收获

ability.desc: 召唤一颗星星落在当前目标身上，从而造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。如果此前曾有一颗星星落至其上，则额外召唤@NumAdditionalStars@颗星星，每颗造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 流星坠落

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>【塔里克】或其绑定的友军首次跌到@PassivePercentHealthThreshold@生命值以下时，两人身上会释放翡翠能量，为@PassiveHexRadius@格内的友军提供持续@PassiveShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%护盾值。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。【塔里克】和其绑定的友军的下@NumAttacks@次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害。
ability.name: 翡翠辉耀

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>来自这个技能的护盾值可以通过<Keyword>技能暴击</Keyword>来产生暴击。\n\n<bright>主动</bright>：为@NumAlliesToShield@名友军提供@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA%护盾和@DamageAmpAmount@伤害增幅，持续@ShieldDuration@秒。随后对其邻格的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。施放@CastThreshold@次后，该技能还会为目标提供@AttackSpeed@可叠加的攻击速度。
ability.name: 种豆得瓜

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>施放时，所有与【拉克丝】拥有同一羁绊的己方弈子获得@ManaCalc1@%i:scaleAP%法力值。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>向最大的敌群发射一道激光，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，每命中一个敌人，该伤害衰减@DamageReductionPerUnit@。
ability.name: 终极闪光

ability.desc: 怒吼，回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值，净化限制效果，并为生命值最低的两名友军回复@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%生命值。然后猛击当前目标，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 凯旋怒吼

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>对距离内的随机敌人进行攻击并对其施加一层流血效果，在@BleedDuration@秒里持续造成共@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。每次攻击有@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%几率造成@SpinningAxeDamageRatio@额外物理伤害并转而施加@SpinningAxeBleedStacks@层流血。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>朝流血层数最多的敌人投掷两把巨斧。对被命中的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc3@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害并消耗他们的流血效果，即刻造成剩余伤害。巨斧随后返回，对命中的敌人造成@GenericCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。如果没有命中任何敌人，则返还@ManaRefund@的法力值花费。
ability.name: 冷血追命

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>普攻对目标邻格的敌人们造成@AttackAoERatio@伤害。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>变成免疫伤害状态并飞到空中。在返程时，对所有敌人造成@StunDuration@秒晕眩，获得@Omnivamp@全能吸血，并对他们施加持续@IgniteDuration@秒的【引燃】。被【引燃】的敌人每秒受到@IgniteMaxHealthDamage@最大生命值的物理伤害。将该技能替换为【烈焰吐息】并立刻施放它。

<Bright>烈焰吐息：</Bright>对贯穿目标的一条敌人最多的直线喷吐火焰，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，每经过1名敌人该伤害衰减@DamageReductionPerHit@(最低至@MinimumDamageThreshold@)。对那些敌人施加持续@IgniteDuration@秒的【引燃】。

远古巨龙霸符：对低于@TraitExecuteThreshold@生命值的敌人造成伤害时会将其处决。
ability.name: 绝伦火热

ability.desc: 系住当前目标，在@TetherDuration@秒里持续造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。随后在其周围释放一道能量爆裂，对半径@AoEHexRange@格内的所有敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，并施加持续@SlowDuration@秒的@SlowPercent@%的<keyword>减速</keyword>效果。\n\n<Rules>减速：降低攻击速度</Rules>
ability.name: 宿业羁绊

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>在玩家对战结束后，你最强的那个【乐芙兰】有@PercentChanceToPrint@的几率生成你场上一个友军的1星复制品，每次参与击杀后提升@PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>向当前目标发射一个镜像，从而造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，并对邻格的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 镜花水月

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>每第三次攻击为双重打击。参与击杀时，获得爆发性的移动速度。

<Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAD%：双重打击提供@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%可叠加的攻击速度。

<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>：双重打击会造成额外伤害并提供治疗。</dim>

ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</bright> Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 

Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.
ability.name: Can You Dig It?

ability.desc:
<bright>被动：</bright>攻击被替换为一次舞蹈，对邻格的所有敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。

<bright>主动：</bright>钻入地下，获得@BurrowDurability@伤害减免，持续@BurrowDuration@秒，并在此期间持续回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。

绿霸符：当友军跌下@TraitHealthThreshold@生命值时，其回复@TraitPercentHeal@最大生命值。
ability.name: 这种快乐你懂吗？

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.
ability.name: Rock and Roll

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>阵亡时，分裂成两个【小型石甲虫】，每个拥有@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值，并且它们会立即进行嘲讽从而迫使敌人们对其进行攻击。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>获得@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%最大生命值，然后滚向目标，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%伤害。

蓝灰霸符：阵亡时，【石甲虫】和【小型石甲虫】为友军提供@TraitShieldHealth@最大生命值的护盾值。
ability.name: 岩之摇滚

ability.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</keyword> for @ManaReaveFlat@.

Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</rules>
ability.name: Azure Shockwave

ability.desc:
获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%护盾值。猛击地面，向敌人最密集的方向发出一道裂隙。被命中的敌人会被短暂击飞，受到@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@ManaReaveFlat@<keyword>破法</keyword>。

蓝霸符：【苍蓝雕纹魔像】每次施放技能时，友军们就会获得@TraitAlliesManaRegen@法力回复。

<rules>破法：提升下一次技能施放的法力消耗。</rules>
ability.name: 蔚蓝冲击波

ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

<bright>Active:</bright> Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Armor.

Red Buff: Attacks @BurnAmount@% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.
ability.name: Crimson Fury

ability.desc:
<bright>被动：</bright>当目标阵亡时，跃至下个目标，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%物理伤害。

<bright>主动：</bright>获得持续@Duration@秒的@FrenzyADPercent@物理加成。在此期间，无视@GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%护甲。

红霸符：攻击@BurnAmount@%灼烧敌人并治疗【绯红印记树怪】@TraitMaxHealthHeal@最大生命值。
ability.name: 猩红之怒

ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.
ability.name: Deadly Plumage

ability.desc: 下@NumAttacks@次攻击获得@AttackSpeed@攻击速度。这些攻击会被替换为羽刃，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害和@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护甲削减。
ability.name: 致死羽衣

ability.desc: <Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a cone. \n\n<Bright>Quest:</Bright> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by @DamageTaken3StarScalar@ at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: Bellows Breath

ability.desc: <Bright>主动：</Bright>获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，并对一个锥形范围内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n<Bright>任务：</Bright>每场玩家对战，【奥恩】将已格挡的伤害储存为【锻炉能量】，在3星时提升@DamageTaken3StarScalar@。他每次获得足够的【锻炉能量】时，就会获得1个【神器锻造器】。<Rules>（锻炉能量：</Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>）</Rules>
ability.name: 风箱炎息

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</dim>
ability.name: Javelin Toss

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>：</Bright>下@NumEmpoweredAttacks@次攻击获得@BonusAttackSpeed@攻击速度。这些攻击被替换为标枪，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。第3次攻击转而瞄准相距最远且携带最少装备的那个敌人，并造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>：变形为一只近战美洲狮刺客来挥击敌人们。</dim>
ability.name: 标枪投掷

ability.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Spirit of Dread

ability.desc: 获得持续3秒的@Resists@护甲与魔抗，并在此期间持续回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。向相距最近的@NumEnemies@名敌人派出幽魂骑兵，从而对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 恐惧之灵

ability.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. \n\nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Forest's Flurry and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).
ability.name: Forest's Flurry

ability.desc: 闪烁远离当前目标，对其造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，并获得@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%攻击速度。\n\n每第四次施放时，会消耗来自【森林疾风】的攻击速度，并释放一道贯穿最大的敌群的震波来造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，它每穿过一个敌人就会降低@DamageReductionPerHit@伤害(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。
ability.name: 森林疾风

ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.
ability.name: Arise!

ability.desc: 接下来的@NumAttacks@次攻击获得@AttackSpeed@攻击速度并召唤@SoldiersToSpawn@个士兵。这些攻击会被替换为指令，来命令每个士兵进行攻击，每次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 沙兵现身

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Restore @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them.
ability.name: Uproot

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>每秒回复@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%生命值，施放技能后的@SpellMultiplierDuration@秒内该效果变为3倍。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>冲出地面，使邻格的敌人们晕眩@KnockupDuration@秒并对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 破土而出

ability.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @Stack@% %i:scaleAP%
ability.name: Primordial Burst

ability.desc:
向目标发射一记巨大震波，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，若其生命值低于@HPThreshold@最大生命值，则提升至@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%。

若目标阵亡，则永久获得@APOnKill@%法术加成。

当前加成：@Stack@% %i:scaleAP%
ability.name: 能量爆裂

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.
ability.name: Sow the Seeds

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每格挡@DamageMitigatedPerSapling@伤害后，一株树苗会跳向附近的一名敌人并造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%魔法伤害。阵亡时，@SaplingsOnDeath@株树苗会跳出。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>对目标造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%魔法伤害并回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%+@ActiveMissingHealthHeal@已损失生命值。
ability.name: 播种

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.
ability.name: Petrified Bark

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，并进入石化状态。护盾被打破时，释放一道黑暗能量波，对@AoEHexRange@格内的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 石化树皮

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.
ability.name: Last Rites

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>阵亡时，生成一个拥有@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleHealth%最大生命值的【夜幽游灵】，并且它会立即进行嘲讽从而迫使敌人们对其进行攻击。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值并打击目标，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。
ability.name: 临终仪式

ability.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.
ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit

ability.desc: 冲刺并向当前目标发射一颗法球，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害并分裂，对附近的@NumSecondaryTargets@名敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。
ability.name: 灵蕴拳

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% physical damage in a large cone.
ability.name: Haymaker

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每场战斗中首次跌至@ManaHPThreshold@最大生命值以下时，获得100法力值。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>蓄力打出一记重拳，从而快速回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值，随后在一个大型锥形范围内造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。
ability.name: 蓄意轰拳

ability.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.
ability.name: Spirit Bomb

ability.desc: 对@AbilityCenterHexRange@格内被最多敌人环绕的那个位置发射一颗灵魄炸弹。它对半径@HexRadius@格内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，与中心的距离每增加1格，该伤害就会衰减@HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@。
ability.name: 灵魄炸弹

ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</Keyword> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>
ability.name: Spirit Rift

ability.desc:
沿敌人最多的那条直线发射一支箭矢，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，这个伤害每命中一个敌人就会衰减@DamageFalloffPerEnemy@(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。如果没有命中任何敌人，则返还@ManaRefund@的法力值花费。

这支箭矢会留下一道持续@RiftDuration@秒的痕迹，对其中的敌人每秒造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%+@MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@最大生命值物理伤害，并施加@ChillPercent@%<Keyword>缓速</Keyword>效果。

<Rules>缓速：降低攻击速度</Rules>
ability.name: 灵魂裂隙

ability.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Spider Queen

ability.desc: 变身为蜘蛛，并获得@SpiderHealthBuff@最大生命值。处于蜘蛛形态时的攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害，并治疗自身@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。后续施放提供在@ASBuffDuration@秒内持续衰减的@DecayingAS@攻击速度。
ability.name: 蜘蛛女皇

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.
ability.name: Headshot

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>每第三次攻击会被替换为一次爆头，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。
ability.name: 爆头

ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.
ability.name: Noxious Blast

ability.desc: 向目标和相距最近未中毒的敌人投毒，从而在@Duration@秒利持续造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。这个毒可以叠加。
ability.name: 瘟毒爆炸

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% more damage per curse.
ability.name: Withering Curse

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>获得@Omnivamp@全能吸血。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>向附近@NumEnemiesCursed@个敌人发射一道黑暗震波，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并诅咒他们@SpellDuration@秒。然后，生成一个半径@HexRangeAOE@格的枯萎地带，持续相同时长并且每秒造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。被诅咒的敌人们受到@MagicDamageCalc3@%i:scaleAP%x诅咒数的额外伤害。
ability.name: 枯萎诅咒

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Entrancing Dance

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值。然后为本回合造成伤害最高的友军提供在@AttackSpeedDuration@秒内持续衰减的@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%攻击速度。
ability.name: 登场之舞

ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.
ability.name: Lilting Lullaby

ability.desc: 回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值，并向附近的敌人们放出@NumEnemiesToFireAt@只蝴蝶。在命中敌人时造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并施加@SleepDuration@秒昏睡。如果目标受到的伤害达到@DamageNeededToAwaken@，则会醒来并额外受到@WakeupDamage@最大生命值的魔法伤害。
ability.name: 夜阑谣

ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Dance of Life

ability.desc: 在@Duration@秒里持续回复共@HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值。下一次攻击被替换为猛击，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 生命之舞

ability.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</bright> @RedRerolls@ Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Green:</bright> @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Yellow:</bright> @YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: Fungus Among Us

ability.desc:
投掷2簇蘑菇，对相距最近的@NumEnemiesHit@个敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。然后猛摔出一个巨型蘑菇，对目标造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。

每次施放有@PercentChanceOfForage@几率搜寻到一个额外的蘑菇，可供收集以获得额外效果。

<bright>红蘑菇：</bright> @RedRerolls@次刷新<Rules>(已搜寻到的红蘑菇：</Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>绿蘑菇：</bright> @GreenHealth@小小英雄生命值<Rules>(已搜寻到的绿蘑菇：</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>黄蘑菇：</bright> @YellowXP@经验值<Rules>(已搜寻到的黄蘑菇：</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>
ability.name: 内有真菌

ability.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.\n\nWhen the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.
ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl

ability.desc: 嘲讽，从而强迫附近的敌人们攻击该弈子。获得持续@Duration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值和@ArmorMR@护甲与魔抗。\n\n护盾被打破时，对@DamageHexRange@格内的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%物理伤害。
ability.name: 尖刺防御

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.
ability.name: Rage Gene

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>每秒获得@RagePerSecond@怒气并且每次攻击提供@RagePerAttack@怒气。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>变形为【巨型纳尔】并跃至@TransformSearchRadius@格内最大的敌群。然后，对@TransformHexRadius@格内的敌人们造成@PhysicalDamageCalc3@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，将其护甲和魔抗降低@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%，并令其晕眩@StunDuration@秒。【巨型纳尔】获得@HealthCalc1@生命值，并将其技能替换为“抓投”。

<Bright>抓投：</Bright>抓住目标并将其投向相距最远的那个敌人，对主要目标造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害，并对途经的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。如果目标是最后存活的1名敌人，则转而将其抛出战场。
ability.name: 狂怒基因

ability.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% for each attack while casting.\n\n<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</Rules>
ability.name: Explosive Charge

ability.desc: 将一个爆炸火花吸附到目标上，持续@Duration@秒。生效期间，获得无限射程和@AttackSpeedCalc1@%i:scaleAP%攻击速度。持续时间结束后，爆炸火花会爆炸并造成由2格内的所有敌人间分摊的伤害，伤害值为@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害+施放期间每次攻击提供额外@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。\n\n<Rules>如果携带爆炸火花的敌人阵亡，那么爆炸火花会吸附至【崔丝塔娜】的新目标。</Rules>
ability.name: 爆炸火花

ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.
ability.name: Boomerang Blade

ability.desc: 投掷一把巨大的十字刃，它会对当前敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，并在附近敌人之间弹跳@NumBounces@次，每次弹跳造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。当这个技能击杀了一个敌人，它会额外弹跳@BonusKillBounces@次。
ability.name: 回旋之刃

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Furious Fists

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>攻击时，回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>发出一声原始怒吼，从而回复@HealthCalc3@%i:scaleAP%生命值。然后获得@SpellAS@攻击速度、@SpellDurability@伤害减免和不可阻挡效果，持续@SpellDuration@秒。
ability.name: 狂怒之拳

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</keyword>, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</dim>
ability.name: Kunai Strike

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>：</Bright>对目标发射一连串苦无，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。如果目标处于<keyword>灼烧</keyword>状态，则额外造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAD%伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>：若该技能完成击杀，则再次施放它。</dim>
ability.name: 苦无打击

ability.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).
ability.name: Piercing Arrow

ability.desc: 蓄力，然后向目标所在且敌人最多的一条直线射出箭矢。它对命中的敌人造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，每穿过一个敌人，该伤害降低@DamageReductionPerHit@(最低为@MinDamagePercent@)。
ability.name: 穿刺之箭

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</Keyword>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</Rules>
ability.name: Tantrum

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>每秒回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%生命值并对@PassiveHexRadius@格内的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@魔法伤害。

<Bright>主动：</Bright>对@BigHexRadius@格内的敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc3@魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩，如果目标处于<Keyword>灼烧</Keyword>状态则延长至@GenericCalc1@秒。

<Rules>灼烧：每秒造成目标一部分最大生命值的真实伤害。</Rules>
ability.name: 勃然大怒

ability.desc: Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</Keyword> enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each. \n\nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Firestorm

ability.desc: 蓄力，每有一名被<Keyword>灼烧</Keyword>的敌人便获得@APPerBurningEnemy@法术加成。随后，获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%护盾值，然后冲刺穿过附近的一群敌人，对每个敌人造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n冲刺后，释放一场半径@FirestormHexRadius@格的火焰风暴，在@FirestormDuration@秒内持续造成共计@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，由所有被命中的敌人均摊。
ability.name: 火焰风暴

ability.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. \n\nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.
ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught

ability.desc: 装备断魄，并在@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAS%秒内对目标连续挥击@Duration@次，每次造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。\n\n攻势结束后，发射一道月光，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害，由半径2格内的所有敌人分摊。
ability.name: 月光对影

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Pale Barrier

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@护盾值，并放出@NumOrbs@颗月光法球，由2格内的所有敌人分摊，每颗造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 苍白屏障

ability.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each.\n\nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.
ability.name: Moonfall

ability.desc: 向@NumEnemies@个最近的敌人降下@NumMoonshards@枚月光碎片，每枚造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。\n\n满月时，月曜降临，造成由所有敌人分摊的@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 月之降临

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Start combat with @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Shield Bash

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>在战斗开始时获得@GenericCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外护甲和魔抗，在@DecayDuration@秒内持续衰减。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>猛击当前目标，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleArmor%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 护盾猛击

ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</Bright> Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks @ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</Keyword> enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</Bright> Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</Rules>
ability.name: Solar Judgement

ability.desc:
<Bright>被动：</Bright>【凯尔】基于其星级获得飞升，并获得可叠加的增益。

<Bright>第1次飞升：</Bright> 普攻造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害。
<Bright>第2次飞升：</Bright> 普攻对命中的敌人施加持续@ShredDuration@秒的@ShredLevel@%<Keyword>魔抗击碎</Keyword>。
<Bright>第3次飞升：</Bright> 普攻发射冲击波，对命中的所有其他弈子造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
<Bright>第4次飞升：</Bright> 获得无限距离。每第@NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@次焰浪变得更大。

<Rules>魔抗击碎：降低魔抗值</Rules>
ability.name: 太阳裁决

ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies hit.
ability.name: Sun's Wrath

ability.desc: 获得持续@ShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%护盾值。然后在一个锥形范围内进行顺劈以造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，并沿直线进行打击，对被命中的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 烈阳之怒

ability.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within @LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage instead and gain @IsolateManaGrant@ mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: Taste Their Fear

ability.desc: 跃向@LeapRangeHexes@格内相距最远的敌人，对其造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。如果其邻格没有其友军，则转而造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害并获得@IsolateManaGrant@法力值。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: 品尝恐惧

ability.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, increased to up to @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: Savagery

ability.desc: 跳向@JumpHexRange@格内生命值百分比最低的那个敌人并刺击，从而造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%物理伤害。然后治疗@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP% 生命值，治疗量基于已损失的生命值至多到 @HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.name: 残忍无情

ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor</Bright> %i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. Enemies below @ADBonusDamageThreshold@ max Health take @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage instead.\n\n<dim>Adaptor</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Damages enemies over time.</dim>
ability.name: Raining Artillery

ability.desc: <Bright>【魔战士】</Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>：</Bright>向目标和相距最近的一个其他敌人喷射酸液，造成@PhysicalDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。低于@ADBonusDamageThreshold@最大生命值的敌人们转而受到@PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%物理伤害。\n\n<dim>【魔战士】</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>：对敌人持续造成伤害。</dim>
ability.name: 天降重炮

ability.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Rampant Growth

ability.desc: 在战场周围生成@NumPlantsToSpawn@株植物，它们会攻击相距最近的敌人@ThornSpitterNumAttacks@次。每次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 狂野生长

ability.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each over the duration.
ability.name: Harvest

ability.desc: 使@NumTargets@个相距最近的敌人的魔抗降低@MRReduction@。然后在@CastDuration@秒里持续从它们身上汲取生命力，从而治疗自身@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值并在此期间持续对每个敌人造成共@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 收获

ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.
ability.name: Starcall

ability.desc: 召唤一颗星星落在当前目标身上，从而造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。如果此前曾有一颗星星落至其上，则额外召唤@NumAdditionalStars@颗星星，每颗造成@MagicDamageCalc2@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。
ability.name: 流星坠落

ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.
ability.name: Emerald Radiance

ability.desc: <Bright>被动：</Bright>【塔里克】或其绑定的友军首次跌到@PassivePercentHealthThreshold@生命值以下时，两人身上会释放翡翠能量，为@PassiveHexRadius@格内的友军提供持续@PassiveShieldDuration@秒的@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%护盾值。\n\n<Bright>主动：</Bright>回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleAP%生命值。【塔里克】和其绑定的友军的下@NumAttacks@次攻击造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%额外魔法伤害。
ability.name: 翡翠辉耀

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</Keyword>. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.
ability.name: Triggerseed

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>来自这个技能的护盾值可以通过<Keyword>技能暴击</Keyword>来产生暴击。\n\n<bright>主动</bright>：为@NumAlliesToShield@名友军提供@ShieldCalc1@%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA%护盾和@DamageAmpAmount@伤害增幅，持续@ShieldDuration@秒。随后对其邻格的敌人们造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害。施放@CastThreshold@次后，该技能还会为目标提供@AttackSpeed@可叠加的攻击速度。
ability.name: 种豆得瓜

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% mana. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.
ability.name: Final Spark

ability.desc: <bright>被动：</bright>施放时，所有与【拉克丝】拥有同一羁绊的己方弈子获得@ManaCalc1@%i:scaleAP%法力值。\n\n<bright>主动：</bright>向最大的敌群发射一道激光，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害，每命中一个敌人，该伤害衰减@DamageReductionPerUnit@。
ability.name: 终极闪光

ability.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Triumphant Roar

ability.desc: 怒吼，回复@HealthCalc1@%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%生命值，净化限制效果，并为生命值最低的两名友军回复@HealthCalc2@%i:scaleAP%生命值。然后猛击当前目标，造成@MagicDamageCalc1@%i:scaleAP%魔法伤害和@StunDuration@秒晕眩。
ability.name: 凯旋怒吼

ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies hit. If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.
ability.name: Whirling Death

zh.desc: 获得一个随机1费英雄强化符文。@TurnDelay@个回合之后，在每个回合开始时，获得该英雄的一个弈子。
zh.name: 主人公

en.desc: Round start Completed Items on benched champions turn into one of their recommended items. Gain a random completed item.
en.name: Psychic Forge

zh.desc: 回合开始时，备战席弈子携带的成装会变成其推荐装备之一。获得1个随机成装。
zh.name: 灵能锻炉

en.desc: Gain a Red Buff. Your Burns deal @BurnIncrease*100@% increased damage.

zh.name: 嗜火

Champions holding exactly 1 item upgrade that item to Radiant. Champions holding Radiant items gain @BonusHealth*100@% Health. Gain @NumRemovers@ Magnetic Removers.

Thief's Gloves counts as multiple items.
en.name: Quality Over Quantity

正好携带1件装备的弈子可将该装备升级为光明武器。携带光明武器的弈子们获得@BonusHealth*100@%生命值。获得@NumRemovers@个【装备拆卸器】。

【窃贼手套】算作多件装备。

en.desc: For the next @NumRounds@ player combats, you cannot use your shop. After, gain @Gold@ gold and a Completed Item Anvil.
en.name: Quiet Quitting

zh.desc: 你在接下来的@NumRounds@个玩家对战回合里无法使用商店。在此之后，获得@Gold@金币和1个【成装锻造器】。
zh.name: 摆烂

en.desc: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next @RoundsOfBonusItems@ rounds, gain a copy of that component.
en.name: Replication

zh.desc: 在3件基础装备中选择1件。在接下来的@RoundsOfBonusItems@回合，获得1件该基础装备。
zh.name: 反响

en.desc:
For every @AugmentRerollTracked@ unused Augment Reroll, gain @ShopRerollToGrant@ free shop rerolls. Gain @Gold@ gold.

Does not include the round this augment is selected.
en.name: Reroll Transfer

zh.desc:
每@AugmentRerollTracked@次未使用的强化符文刷新，可获得@ShopRerollToGrant@次免费商店刷新。获得@Gold@金币。

不包含这个强化符文被选择的那个回合。
zh.name: 刷新转换

en.desc: Remove all champions on your board and bench. Gain @3Cost@ random 2-star 3-costs, @2Cost@ 2-star 2-costs, and @1Cost@ 2-star 1-cost champion.
en.name: Restart Mission

zh.desc: 移除你场上和备战席上的所有弈子。获得@3Cost@个随机的2星3费弈子、@2Cost@个2星2费弈子和@1Cost@个2星1费弈子。
zh.name: 重启任务

en.desc:
Gain @ItemCount@ Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}
en.name: Retribution

zh.desc:
获得@ItemCount@个【正义之手】。装备【正义之手】的友方获得技能暴击和@CritChance*100@%暴击几率。

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}
zh.name: 正义报复

en.desc: Your next shop and every @NumRolls@ shops will contain all 3-cost champions. Gain @Rerolls@ rerolls.
en.name: Rigged Shop+

zh.desc: 你的下一次和每@NumRolls@次商店刷新都将是全3费弈子。获得@Rerolls@次刷新。
zh.name: 操纵商店+

en.desc:
After you earn @GoldRequired@ gold in interest, gain @GoldToGain@ gold. Your max interest is increased to @InterestCap@. Gain @GoldNow@ gold now.

Gold earned: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount_Tracker@
en.name: Savings Account

zh.desc:
在你通过利息赚取@GoldRequired@金币后，获得@GoldToGain@金币。你的最大利息提升至@InterestCap@金币。立刻获得@GoldNow@金币。

已赚取的金币：@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount_Tracker@
zh.name: 储蓄账户

en.desc: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants @IncreasedMana@ additional Mana Regen if its holder has @APThreshold@% or more Ability Power.
en.name: Seraphim's Staff

zh.desc: 获得1个【大天使之杖】。如果【大天使之杖】的携带者拥有@APThreshold@%或以上的法术加成，【大天使之杖】还会为其额外提供@IncreasedMana@法力回复。
zh.name: 炽天使之拥

en.desc:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. In @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Gamblers Blade.

These items give gold as well as combat power.
en.name: Shimmerscale Essence

zh.desc:
获得1个【大亨之铠】。在@combatnum@回合内，获得1个【投机者之刃】。

这些装备会在提供战斗力的同时给予金币。
zh.name: 金鳞精萃

en.desc: Your team gains @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @Mana@ Mana. Gain a B.F. Sword and a Tear of the Goddess.
en.name: Spear's Will

zh.desc: 你的队伍获得@AD*100@%物理加成和@Mana@法力值。获得1个【暴风大剑】和1个【女神之泪】。

zh.desc: 友军受到治疗时，对目标造成相当于治疗值@HealConversionPct*100@%的魔法伤害。每@HealInterval@秒，友军回复@HealPct*100@%最大生命值。

en.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

zh.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和@Gold@金币。

en.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.
en.name: Silver Destiny+

zh.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 白银命运+

en.desc: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.
en.name: Silver Destiny++

zh.desc: 获得1个随机白银阶强化符文和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 白银命运++

en.desc: Gain a Giant's Belt. After a champion starts combat with more than @HealthRequired@ max Health, gain a Warmog's Armor.
en.name: Size Matters

zh.desc: 获得1个【巨人腰带】。一个弈子在开始战斗之后拥有的最大生命值高于@HealthRequired@，获得1个【狂徒铠甲】。
zh.name: 尺寸至上

en.desc: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving @Max5Costs@ 5-cost champion.
en.name: Slice of Life

en.desc: Gain @NumComponents@ random item components.
en.name: Small Grab Bag

zh.desc: 提供@NumComponents@件随机基础装备。
zh.name: 小小福袋

en.desc: For the next @NumCombats@ combats, your team size is 1 but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain @XPPerKill@ XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain @NumComponents@ item components.
en.name: Solo Leveling

zh.desc: 在接下来的@NumCombats@个战斗回合，你的小队规模为1，但你登场的那个弈子拥有巨幅提升过的各属性。该弈子的每次击杀都会使你获得@XPPerKill@经验。在此之后，获得@NumComponents@件基础装备。
zh.name: 独自升级

en.desc:
Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain @GoldAmount@ gold.

Fates Championship, 2021
en.name: Speedy Double Kill

zh.desc:
获得1个【鬼索的狂暴之刃】。当2名玩家淘汰后，获得@GoldAmount@金币。

2021【命运之轮】全球总决赛
zh.name: 一波带走俩

en.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems and @Gold@ gold.
