zh.desc: 获得@NumOfEmblems@个随机纹章和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 蔓延之根

en.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.
en.name: Spreading Roots+

zh.desc: 获得@NumOfEmblems@个随机纹章、一个【装备重铸器】和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 蔓延之根+

en.desc:
Collect Golden Balls by defeating players in combat. Collect all @WinsPerReward@ for a reward, then restart the quest with more powerful rewards.

Gain a 2-star 1-cost champion to start your journey.
en.name: A Story of Seven

zh.desc:
通过在对战中击败玩家来收集金珠。收集所有@WinsPerReward@颗即可获得一份奖励，随后重新开始拥有更多强力奖励的任务。

获得1个2星1费弈子以开始你的旅程。
zh.name: 七金珠

en.desc: Now and at the start of each Stage, open a Shop of 4 unique 4-cost champions and gain @GoldPerStage@ gold.
en.name: Subscription Service

zh.desc: 现在以及每个阶段开始时，开启一个由4个独特4费弈子组成的商店，并获得@GoldPerStage@金币。
zh.name: 订阅服务

en.desc: Gain @InitialGold@ gold. After @PlayersDead@ players are eliminated, gain @Gold@ more gold.
en.name: Survivor

zh.desc: 获得@InitialGold@金币。在@PlayersDead@名玩家被淘汰后，获得@Gold@额外金币。
zh.name: 幸存者

en.desc:
Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains @HealthPerItem@ Health for each item equipped on champions.

Health Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SweetTreats_TeamHealth@

Magic N' Mayhem Tactician's Crown, 2024
en.name: Sweet Treats

zh.desc:
获得1个【神器锻造器】。弈子每携带1个装备，你的队伍就获得@HealthPerItem@生命值。

已获得的生命值：@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SweetTreats_TeamHealth@

2024【魔法大乱斗】全球总决赛
zh.name: 甜点

en.desc: Gain @NumItems@ B.F. Swords. Your B.F. Swords grant +@BonusStat*100@% Attack Speed.
en.name: Sword Overflow

zh.desc: 获得 @NumItems@个【暴风大剑】。你的【暴风大剑】提供+@BonusStat*100@%攻击速度。
zh.name: 大剑溢流

en.desc: After the next @NumStages@ carousels, gain one champion that was not taken and its item. Gain @Gold@ gold.

zh.desc: 接下来的@NumStages@个选秀回合后，获得1个未被选走的弈子和其装备。获得@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 餐桌剩菜

en.desc: Gain a random Emblem. After @TurnDelay@ rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.
en.name: Tactician's Kitchen

en.desc:
Gain a random Tank item. After @StartSeconds@ seconds of combat, your team gains @Stats@% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

TFT Paris Open, 2025
en.name: Baron's Lair

zh.desc:
获得一件随机坦克装备。在战斗开始@StartSeconds@秒后，你的弈子们会在战斗环节的剩余时间里每秒获得@Stats@%额外物理加成和法术加成。

2025云顶之弈巴黎公开赛
zh.name: 男爵幻域

en.name: Blood Offering

zh.desc: 获得1个【饮血剑】。战斗开始时：携带【饮血剑】的己方弈子失去@HPLossPercent*100@%生命值，但是获得一个@HPShieldPercent*100@%生命值的护盾和@BonusAD*100@%物理加成和法术加成。
zh.name: 鲜血祭品

en.desc:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up 2 team slots but gain @BonusHealth@ Health and @DurabilityPct*100@% Durability.

Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power.
Dragonlands Championship, 2022
en.name: The Golden Dragon

zh.desc:
获得1个【大亨之铠】。携带【大亨之铠】的弈子占用2个弈子栏位，但获得@BonusHealth@生命值和@DurabilityPct*100@%伤害减免。

【大亨之铠】提供金币，以及战斗力。
2022【巨龙之境】全球总决赛

zh.desc: 获得1个拥有额外生命值(随阶段提升)的巨大训练假人。每@ZapInterval@秒，电击距离最近的@ZapCount@个敌人，造成@MaxHealthPct*100@%最大生命值的真实伤害。

Gain a random item component. Every @ManaPerComponent@ Mana your team spends grants an additional component (max @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_NumComponents@/@ComponentMax@).

Mana spent: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_TrackedMana@/@ManaPerComponent@

获得1件随机基础装备。你的小队每消耗@ManaPerComponent@法力值，就会提供1个额外基础装备(装备获得进度@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_NumComponents@/@ComponentMax@)。

已消耗的法力值：@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_TrackedMana@/@ManaPerComponent@
zh.name: 纺织魔法

en.desc: Gain a Bramble Vest. Your Bramble Vests deal @damageamp1*100@-@damageamp4*100@% more damage (based on Stage).
en.name: Thorn-Plated Armor

zh.desc: 获得1个【棘刺背心】。你的【棘刺背心】多造成@damageamp1*100@-@damageamp4*100@%伤害(基于阶段)。
zh.name: 棘刺镀板铠甲

en.desc: Disable your Shop for the next @PenaltyTurns@ rounds. Then gain @Experience@ XP.

zh.desc: 在接下来的@PenaltyTurns@个回合中禁用你的商店。然后获得@Experience@经验值。

en.desc: Increase your current and max player Health by @Heal@. On carousel rounds you are released earlier, but are much slower.
en.name: Titanic Titan

zh.desc: 使你的当前和最大玩家生命值都提升@Heal@。你会在选秀中更早被放出，但速度要慢得多。

en.desc: For the next @NumDead@ players eliminated, choose one of their completed items to keep.
en.name: Tomb Raider I

zh.desc: 从接下来被淘汰的@NumDead@名玩家留下的成装中选择一件据为己有。
zh.name: 盗墓者 I

en.desc: Gain @NumInitialItems@ completed item anvil. Every time a player is eliminated, choose one of their completed items to keep.
en.name: Tomb Raider II

zh.desc: 获得@NumInitialItems@个【成装锻造器】。每有一位玩家被淘汰，即可选择该玩家的一件成装据为己有。
zh.name: 盗墓者 II

en.desc: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain @AD*100@% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.
en.name: Deadlier Blades

zh.desc: 获得1个【死亡之刃】。【死亡之刃】的携带者每参与击杀一次，【死亡之刃】就会永久获得@AD*100@%物理加成。
zh.name: 更要命的战刃

en.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.
en.name: The Trait Tree

zh.desc: 获得@NumOfEmblems@个随机纹章、一个【装备重铸器】和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 羁绊树

en.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.
en.name: The Trait Tree+

zh.desc: 获得@NumOfEmblems@个随机纹章、一个【装备重铸器】和@Gold@金币。
zh.name: 羁绊树+

en.desc: Gain a locked chest each Stage between now and Stage @MaxNumChests@. Unlock each chest when you spend @GoldNeededPerChest@ gold on Shop rerolls. These chests persist until opened.
en.name: Treasure Hunt

zh.desc: 在现在和第@MaxNumChests@阶段之间的每个阶段获得一个上锁的宝箱。当你在商店刷新上花费@GoldNeededPerChest@金币时，即可解锁一个宝箱。这些宝箱会存留至被打开为止。
zh.name: 寻宝

en.desc:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
en.name: Trifecta I

zh.desc:
获得@numunits@个@Tier@费弈子。
战斗开始时：@BuffedNumber@个随机@Tier@费英雄获得@Health@生命值和@AttackSpeed*100@%攻击速度。
zh.name: 三项赛 I

en.desc:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions. Allies gain @TeamAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
en.name: Trifecta II

zh.desc:
获得@numunits@个@Tier@费弈子。己方弈子获得@TeamAttackSpeed*100@%攻击速度。
战斗开始时：@BuffedNumber@个随机@Tier@费英雄获得@Health@生命值和@AttackSpeed*100@%攻击速度。
zh.name: 三项赛 II

en.desc: If you have exactly @NumUnits@ allies in your first row, grant them @BonusHealth@ bonus Health, @BonusAR@ Armor, and @BonusMR@ Magic Resist.
en.name: Twin Guardians

zh.desc: 如果你的第一排有且只有@NumUnits@个弈子，为他们提供@BonusHealth@额外生命值、@BonusAR@护甲和@BonusMR@魔抗。
zh.name: 双子守护神

en.desc: Gain @FreeRerolls@ reroll for every @UnitCount@ unique 2-cost champions fielded last player combat. Gain @NumChampsToGrant@ 2-cost champions.
en.name: Two Much Value

zh.desc: 上一场玩家对战中每登场过@UnitCount@个独特的2费弈子，就获得@FreeRerolls@次商店刷新。获得@NumChampsToGrant@个2费弈子。

en.desc: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain @BonusHealth@ Health. When one copy dies, the other gains a @OnDeathPercHeal*100@% max Health Shield for @HealDuration@ seconds. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

zh.desc: 如果你恰好登场了相同英雄的2个弈子，那么他们都会获得@BonusHealth@生命值。在其中一个弈子阵亡时，另一个获得持续@HealDuration@秒的相当于@OnDeathPercHeal*100@%最大生命值的护盾值。当你将弈子升到3星时，获得该英雄的1个2星弈子。

en.desc: Whenever your team has fewer allies alive than your opponent, regenerate @MissingHeal@% missing Health each second (Max: @HealCap@).

zh.desc: 当你还存活的弈子的数量比敌人少时，你的弈子们会每秒回复@MissingHeal@%已损失生命值(最大值：@HealCap@)。

zh.desc: 每回合，你的队伍获得@Stats@%物理加成和法术加成。英雄们初始拥有@StartingStacks@层此效果，并且至多可叠加至@MaxStacks@层。

Gain a Nashor's Tooth, a Jeweled Gauntlet, a Needlessly Large Rod and a Magnetic Remover.

Useful for Magic Carries!

获得1个【纳什之牙】、1个【珠光护手】、1个【无用大棒】、和1个【装备拆卸器】。

en.name: Masterwork Upgrade

zh.name: 杰作升级

en.desc:
Use on a champion to create a 1-star copy on your bench.

[Consumable - This item disappears when used.]

zh.desc:
用在一位英雄身上，即可生成一个该英雄的1星版本到你的备战区。

[消耗品 - 这个物品会在使用后消失。]

Use on a champion to reroll a special Shop that contains only champions sharing a Trait with the source champion.

[Consumable - This item disappears when used.]

zh.desc:
对一个英雄使用这个，即可使商店进行一次特殊刷新且该次刷新仅包含与该英雄拥有一个相同羁绊的英雄。

[消耗品 - 这个物品会在使用后消失。]

en.desc:
Use on a champion to spawn a movable Training Dummy nearby.

[Cannot be used in combat.
Consumable - This item disappears when used.]

zh.desc:
用在一位英雄身上，即可在附近生成一个可移动的目标假人。

[无法在战斗环节中使用。
消耗品 - 这个物品会在使用后消失。]
zh.name: 训练假人

en.desc:
Unequip all items and randomly transform them into new ones of a similar type and quality.
Trash to Treasure: Completed items transform into Artifacts and do not consume the Reforger

[Consumable - This item disappears when used.]
en.name: Reforger

zh.desc:
拆卸所有装备并将它们随机转化为相似类型和品质的全新装备。
变废为宝：成装转化为神器并且不会消耗掉这个重铸器。

[消耗品 - 这个装备会在使用后消失。]
zh.name: 装备重铸器

en.desc:
Gain an additional @ManaPercIncrease*100@% Mana from all sources. The holder gains an additional bonus based on their Role:

Tanks and Fighters: Gain @FrontlineResists@ Armor and Magic Resistance.

Other Roles: Gain @BacklineADAP@% Attack Damage and Ability Power.
en.name: Adaptive Helm

zh.desc:
从所有来源中获得额外的@ManaPercIncrease*100@%法力值。携带者获得基于角色定位的一个额外加成：

坦克和战士：获得@FrontlineResists@护甲和魔抗。

其它角色定位：获得@BacklineADAP@%物理加成和法术加成。
zh.name: 适应性头盔

en.desc:
Combat start: Grant @ASBuff@% Attack Speed and @BonusResists@ Armor and Magic Resist to the holder, adjacent allies in the same row, and all allies behind them for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

​​[Support item]
en.name: Aegis of the Legion

zh.desc:
战斗开始时：提供@ASBuff@%攻击速度和@BonusResists@护甲与魔抗给携带者、同一排的邻格友军、以及携带者身后的友军，持续@BuffDuration@秒。​​

​​[辅助装]
zh.name: 军团圣盾

en.desc: Combat start: Gain @APPerInterval@% Ability Power every @IntervalSeconds@ seconds in combat.
en.name: Archangel's Staff

zh.desc: 战斗开始时：在战斗期间，每@IntervalSeconds@秒获得@APPerInterval@%法术加成。
zh.name: 大天使之杖

en.desc:
Every @TickRate@ seconds, steal @ArmorStealPerTick@ Armor from enemies within 1-hex and heal @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_AegisDuskDawn_Damage@% of the holder's Armor.

If Aegis of Dusk is also equipped, trigger this item's effect every @TickRateWithAegisOfDusk@ seconds instead.

Healing increases based on Stage.
en.name: Aegis of Dawn

zh.desc:
每@TickRate@秒，从1格内的敌人们处偷取@ArmorStealPerTick@护甲，并治疗相当于携带者@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_AegisDuskDawn_Damage@%护甲值的生命值。

如果还携带了【黄昏圣盾】，则转而每@TickRateWithAegisOfDusk@秒触发这件装备的效果。

治疗效果基于阶段提升。
zh.name: 黎明圣盾

en.desc:
Every @TickRate@ seconds, steal @MRStealPerTick@ Magic Resist from enemies within 1 hex and deal @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_AegisDuskDawn_Damage@% of the holder's Magic Resist as magic damage.

If Aegis of Dawn is also equipped, trigger this item's effect every @TickRateWithAegisOfDawn@ seconds instead.

Damage increases based on Stage.
en.name: Aegis of Dusk

zh.desc:
每@TickRate@秒，从1格内的敌人们处偷取@MRStealPerTick@魔抗，并造成相当于携带者@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_AegisDuskDawn_Damage@%魔抗值的魔法伤害。

如果还携带了【黎明圣盾】，则转而每@TickRateWithAegisOfDawn@秒触发这件装备的效果。

伤害基于阶段提升。
zh.name: 黄昏圣盾

en.desc:
Dealing magic damage reduces the target's Magic Resist by @MRReduction@. If their Magic Resist is 0, grant the holder @ManaGain@ Mana instead.

Ability damage can only trigger on each enemy once every @ICD@ seconds.
en.name: Blighting Jewel

zh.desc:
造成魔法伤害时会将目标的魔抗削减@MRReduction@。如果目标的魔抗是0，则转而会为携带者提供@ManaGain@法力值。

技能伤害每@ICD@秒仅能在每个敌人身上触发一次此效果。
zh.name: 枯萎珠宝

en.desc: The holder dons a Hat on each takedown. The holder gains @ADAPPerTakedown@% Attack Damage and Ability Power per Hat. On death lose @PercentHatLoss*100@% of all Hats. (Hats: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Item_Artifact_CappaJuice_NumHats@)
en.name: Cappa Juice

zh.desc: 携带者在每次参与击杀后带上一顶帽子。携带者从每顶帽子中获得@ADAPPerTakedown@%物理加成和法术加成。阵亡时，失去@PercentHatLoss*100@%总帽子数。 (帽子数： @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Item_Artifact_CappaJuice_NumHats@)
zh.name: 帽子饮品

en.desc:
Attacks deal an additional @PercentDamage@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% as physical damage and heal the holder for the damage dealt.

The holder cannot cast their Ability or gain Mana.
en.name: Corrupt Vampiric Scepter

zh.desc:
攻击造成相当于@PercentDamage@%物理加成%i:scaleAD%的额外物理伤害并且携带者治疗相当于这个已造成伤害值的生命值。

携带者不能施放其技能或获得法力值。
zh.name: 黑暗吸血鬼节杖

en.desc: Reduce the holder's max Mana by @FlatManaReduction@. Subsequent spellcasts reduce max Mana by @ReductionPerCast*100@%, to a minimum of @MinimumTotalMana@.
en.name: Dawncore

zh.desc: 携带者的最大法力值缩减@FlatManaReduction@。后续的技能施放会使最大法力值缩减@ReductionPerCast*100@%，直至最小值@MinimumTotalMana@。
zh.name: 黎明核心

en.desc:
Combat start: Form a pact with the highest Health allied champion, if they die, gain @ManaRegenToGrant@ Mana regen and @APToGrant@% Ability Power.

When the ally uses their ability, gain @ManaToGrant@ Mana. Every @ShieldCadence@ seconds, shield your ally for @PercentAPShield*100@% of the holder's Ability Power.
en.name: Eternal Pact

zh.desc:
战斗开始时：与生命值最高的那个友方弈子形成一个契约，如果其阵亡，则获得@ManaRegenToGrant@法力回复和@APToGrant@%法术加成。

当该友军使用其技能时，获得@ManaToGrant@法力值。每@ShieldCadence@秒，为该友军提供护盾值，数额相当于携带者的@PercentAPShield*100@%法术加成。
zh.name: 永恒契约

en.desc: The holder's attacks target random enemies.
en.name: Fishbones

zh.desc: 携带者的攻击会瞄准随机的敌人。
zh.name: 鱼骨头

en.desc: Shields have @PercentShieldConversion@% of their value converted to max Health instead.
en.name: Forbidden Idol

zh.desc: 护盾效果会将其@PercentShieldConversion@%的护盾值转化为最大生命值作为替代。
zh.name: 禁忌雕像

en.desc: Attacks deal @MaxHealthPercentDamage*100@% of the holder's max Health as bonus physical damage. For every @MissingHealthPercent*100@% missing Health, gain @ASPerMissingHealthPercent*100@% Attack Speed.
en.name: Hellfire Hatchet

zh.desc: 攻击造成相当于携带者@MaxHealthPercentDamage*100@%最大生命值的额外物理伤害。每@MissingHealthPercent*100@%已损失生命值，获得@ASPerMissingHealthPercent*100@%攻击速度。
zh.name: 恶火小斧

en.desc:
The holder gains @PercentMana@% of their total Mana whenever they're hit by an attack.

Each cast restores @PercentHealth@% of the holder's max Health over @Duration@ seconds.
en.name: Innervating Locket

zh.desc:
携带者每被一次攻击命中时，都会获得其@PercentMana@%的总法力值。

每次技能施放会在@Duration@秒里持续回复携带者的@PercentHealth@%最大生命值。
zh.name: 激发之匣

en.desc:
Share @StatSharePercent*100@% of the holder's bonus Attack Damage, Ability Power, Attack Speed, Armor, Magic Resist, and Health with other Mirrored Persona holders.

Can't be Reforged
Unique: one per champion
en.name: Lesser Mirrored Persona

zh.desc:
分享携带者@StatSharePercent*100@%的额外物理加成、法术加成、攻击速度、护甲、魔抗和生命值至其它【镜像人格面具】携带者们。

无法被重铸
唯一：一个弈子仅限一件
zh.name: 次级镜像人格面具

en.desc:
The holder's first attack after each Ability cast deals @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_LichBane_Damage@ bonus magic damage.

Damage increases based on Stage.
en.name: Lich Bane

zh.desc:
携带者在每次技能施放后的第一次攻击造成@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_LichBane_Damage@额外魔法伤害。

这个伤害基于阶段而提升。
zh.name: 巫妖之祸

en.desc:
Every @TriggerRate@ seconds, Shields the lowest percent Health ally for @PercentOfResists@% of the holder's combined Armor and Magic Resist for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

On death grants this shield to all allies.
en.name: Lightshield Crest

zh.desc:
每@TriggerRate@秒，为生命值百分比最低的那个友军提供护盾，护盾值相当于携带者@PercentOfResists@%的护甲与魔抗总和，持续@ShieldDuration@秒。

在阵亡时，将这个护盾效果提供给所有友军。
zh.name: 光盾徽章

en.desc: @PercentOfOverkill@% of overkill damage plus @BaseDamage@ is dealt as magic damage to the two enemies nearest to the target.
en.name: Luden's Tempest

zh.desc: 在击杀目标时，会对与目标相距最近的两个敌人造成魔法伤害，伤害值为过量伤害的@PercentOfOverkill@%外加@BaseDamage@。
zh.name: 卢登的激荡

en.desc: Increase healing on the holder by @IncreasedHealing*100@%. When the holder gives or receives a heal, grant @HealPercentToGrant*100@% of the heals value to the lowest health ally as well.
en.name: Mending Echoes

zh.desc: 携带者身上的治疗效果提升@IncreasedHealing*100@%。当携带者给予或收到一次治疗时，也为生命值最低的那个友军提供@HealPercentToGrant*100@%该治疗效果。
zh.name: 修复型回响

en.desc:
Every @NumCombats@ player combats gain a lesser copy of Mirrored Persona (@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Item_Artifact_MirroredPersona_Combats@/@NumCombats@).

Share @StatSharePercent*100@% of the holder's bonus Attack Damage, Ability Power, Attack Speed, Armor, Magic Resist, and Health with other Mirrored Persona holders.

Can't be Reforged, Lesser copies do not produce copies.
Unique: one per champion
en.name: Mirrored Persona

zh.desc:
每@NumCombats@场玩家对战提供【镜像人格面具】的一个次级副本(@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Item_Artifact_MirroredPersona_Combats@/@NumCombats@)。

分享携带者@StatSharePercent*100@%的额外物理加成、法术加成、攻击速度、护甲、魔抗和生命值至其它【镜像人格面具】携带者们。

无法被重铸，次级副本不会产生副本。
唯一：一个弈子仅限一件
zh.name: 镜像人格面具

en.desc:
Shrinks the holder, granting them increased movement speed and immunity to Slow, Burn, and Wound.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
{{TFT_Keyword_Burn}}
{{TFT_Keyword_Wound}}
en.name: Mittens

zh.desc:
将携带者缩小，为其提供移动速度提升并免疫减速、灼烧以及重伤。

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
{{TFT_Keyword_Burn}}
{{TFT_Keyword_Wound}}
zh.name: 连指手套

en.desc: Attacks grant @ASPerStack*100@% stacking Attack Speed. Every @StacksPerBonus@ attacks also grant @ADPerBonus*100@% Attack Damage and @APPerBonus@% Ability Power.
en.name: Flickerblades

zh.desc: 攻击提供@ASPerStack*100@%可叠加的攻击速度。每@StacksPerBonus@次攻击还会提供@ADPerBonus*100@%物理加成和@APPerBonus@%法术加成。
zh.name: 烁刃

en.desc: After killing a target, shed negative effects and dash to the farthest target within @HexRange@ hexes. The next 2 critical attacks deal @CritDamageBonusPercent@% bonus Critical Strike Damage.
en.name: Prowler's Claw

zh.desc: 在击杀一个目标后，摆脱负面效果并冲刺到@HexRange@格内相距最远的那个目标处。下两次暴击攻击造成@CritDamageBonusPercent@%额外暴击伤害。
zh.name: 暗行者之爪

en.desc: Gain +1 Attack Range, increased by 1 whenever the holder kills an enemy.
en.name: Rapid Firecannon

zh.desc: 获得+1攻击距离，并且这个距离会在携带者每击杀一个敌人时提升1。
zh.name: 疾射火炮

en.desc: Takedowns increase the holder's Armor, Magic Resist, and Ability Power by @StatsPerTakedown@.
en.name: Seeker's Armguard

zh.desc: 参与击杀后会使携带者的护甲、魔抗和法术加成提升@StatsPerTakedown@。
zh.name: 探索者的护臂

en.desc:
Spawn a clone that copies the holder's items. The clone has @ClonePercentHealth*100@% max Health and deals @ClonePercentDamage*100@% damage.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
en.name: Shadow Puppet

zh.desc:
生成一个复制体，且该复制体复制了携带者的各装备。复制体拥有@ClonePercentHealth*100@%最大生命值，并造成@ClonePercentDamage*100@%伤害。

[唯一：一个弈子仅限一件]
zh.name: 暗影木偶

en.desc:
Grants immunity to Stuns and the holder's attacks Stun the target for @StunDuration@ seconds.

The holder's Attack Speed is locked at @AttackSpeedCap@.
en.name: Silvermere Dawn

zh.desc:
为携带者提供免疫晕眩，并且携带者的攻击可以使目标晕眩@StunDuration@秒。

携带者的攻击速度被锁定在@AttackSpeedCap@。
zh.name: 密银黎明

en.desc: Combat start: Teleport the holder to the mirrored hex on the enemy's side of the board. After @Duration@ seconds, the holder returns to their original location.
en.name: Spectral Cutlass

zh.desc: 战斗开始时：将携带者传送到敌方一侧的镜像格上。在@Duration@秒后，携带者返回其原本的位置。
zh.name: 幽魂弯刀

en.desc: Every 3rd attack deals @Damage@ + @APScalar*100@% of the holder's Ability Power as additional magic damage to 4 enemies.
en.name: Statikk Shiv

zh.desc: 每第3次攻击对4名敌人造成@Damage@+@APScalar*100@%携带者法术加成的额外魔法伤害。
zh.name: 斯塔缇克电刃

en.desc:
Once per combat at @PercentHealthTrigger@% Health, the holder splits into 3 copies of themself each with @PercentHealthOfCopies@% of their max Health.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
en.name: Suspicious Trench Coat

zh.desc:
每回合一次，在@PercentHealthTrigger@%生命值时，携带者分裂为自己的3个复制体，每个都有拥有其@PercentHealthOfCopies@%最大生命值。

[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]
zh.name: 迷离风衣

en.desc: After @Seconds@ seconds gain @MaxHealthPercent@% max Health and @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp for the rest of combat.
en.name: Talisman Of Ascension

zh.desc: 在@Seconds@秒后，获得@MaxHealthPercent@%最大生命值和@DamageAmp*100@%伤害增幅，持续到战斗环节结束。
zh.name: 飞升护符

en.desc:
The holder's Move Speed is drastically reduced.

Gain @HealthPercBonus*100@% max Health, stun immunity, and pull the current target into melee range.
en.name: The Indomitable

zh.desc:
携带者的移动速度大幅降低。

获得@HealthPercBonus*100@%最大生命值、晕眩免疫，并将当前目标拉到近战距离。
zh.name: 顽强不屈

en.desc: Attacks deal @PercentMaxHealthSplash@% of the holder's max Health plus @PercentAttackDamageSplash@% of their Attack Damage as bonus physical damage to the target and adjacent enemies.
en.name: Titanic Hydra

zh.desc: 攻击对目标和邻格敌人造成相当于携带者@PercentMaxHealthSplash@%最大生命值外加@PercentAttackDamageSplash@%物理加成的额外物理伤害。
zh.name: 巨型九头蛇

en.desc: Whenever a Shield on the holder breaks, @PercentDamage@% of that Shield's initial value is dealt to the nearest enemy as magic damage.
en.name: Unending Despair

zh.desc: 每当携带者身上的一个护盾被打破时，就会对相距最近的那个敌人造成该护盾的@PercentDamage@%初始护盾值的魔法伤害。
zh.name: 无终恨意

en.desc:
Combat start: Store @InitialPercentHealthStore*100@% max Health and @PercentHealthStore*100@% more every second. On death, unleash the stored Health as magic damage split between enemies within @HexRadius@-hexes.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
en.name: Void Gauntlet

zh.desc:
战斗开始时：储存@InitialPercentHealthStore*100@％最大生命值，并且每秒多储存@PercentHealthStore*100@%。在阵亡时，释放相当于生命值储量的魔法伤害，分摊给半径@HexRadius@格内的敌人们。

[唯一：一个弈子仅限一件]
zh.name: 虚空护手

en.desc:
Attacks deal @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_WitsEnd_Damage@ bonus magic damage.

Heals the holder for @PercentHealing@% of all magic damage dealt.

Damage increases based on Stage.
en.name: Wit's End

zh.desc:
攻击造成@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_Artifact_WitsEnd_Damage@额外魔法伤害。

治疗携带者，数额为@PercentHealing@%的所有已造成魔法伤害。

这个伤害基于阶段而提升。
zh.name: 智慧末刃

en.desc: %i:scaleAD% +@AD*100@% Attack Damage
en.name: B.F. Sword

zh.desc: %i:scaleAD% +@AD*100@%物理加成
zh.name: 暴风之剑

en.desc:
Combat start: Grant the holder and allies within @HexRange@ hexes in the same row immunity to crowd control and @BuffAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds.

[Support item] [Unique - only 1 per champion]

sections.title: When you own 3-star Riftbeasts
sections.note: A Riftbeast you own at 3 stars, on the board or on the bench, never appears in your overrun shop again. What fills its place depends on how many of the seven 1 to 3 cost Riftbeasts you have at 3 stars. The higher costs do not matter.
rows: Some 1 to 3 cost Riftbeast is still below 3 stars
The shop tries up to 3 lineups of its level for one that stays complete. Otherwise the empty slots get 1-star copies of the cheapest Riftbeast you have not 3-starred yet. No 3-star copies.
All seven 1 to 3 cost Riftbeasts are at 3 stars

[[champion:Brambleback]], [[champion:Sentinel]] and [[champion:Elder Dragon]] fill the empty slots first, at 1 star and each at most once, only while you hold at most one copy of it and none above 1 star. Every slot still empty gets the cheapest Riftbeast you do not own at 4 stars: the first two copies at 3 stars (9 gold for a 1-cost), any further copy at 1 star.
At level 5 to 7 in that state

The lineups hold only 1 to 3 costs, so the whole shop is refilled: [[champion:Brambleback]], [[champion:Sentinel]] and [[champion:Elder Dragon]] plus two 3-star copies, while all three are still eligible.
At level 8 to 10 in that state
The lineups already hold [[champion:Brambleback]], [[champion:Sentinel]] and [[champion:Elder Dragon]], so fewer slots are empty: none to two 3-star copies per shop.

Each copy is drawn at random from the cheapest cost you have not 4-starred, so at the 1-cost tier a shop gives [[champion:Cinderling]] or [[champion:Pebbles]] for each copy. A copy you cannot combine yet waits on the bench for the next shop.
